# Dr. Christopher S. Sales, MD, MPH — Ophthalmology

> Board-certified ophthalmologist specializing in DMEK corneal transplant surgery, cataract surgery, EVO ICL vision correction, and dry eye treatment. Practicing at Starling Physicians in Wethersfield and New Britain, Connecticut.

## About Dr. Sales
- [About](/about): Board-certified ophthalmologist trained at Brown, Tufts, Harvard, Stanford, and the University of Iowa. Former faculty at Weill Cornell and University of Iowa. 50+ peer-reviewed publications, National Academy of Inventors inductee (2023), Gold Medal for Endothelial Keratoplasty (2024). Founder of Oko-Tek Inc.

## Services
- [Corneal Transplant (DMEK)](/services/corneal-transplant): DMEK (Descemet Membrane Endothelial Keratoplasty) — the most advanced corneal transplant for Fuchs' Dystrophy and corneal endothelial disease. Dr. Sales pioneered DMEK in New York City and has trained surgeons worldwide.
- [Cataract Surgery](/services/cataract): Advanced cataract surgery with premium lens options including multifocal, toric, and extended depth of focus lenses. Laser-assisted options available.
- [EVO ICL Vision Correction](/services/vision-correction): EVO Implantable Collamer Lens for myopia correction without permanently altering the cornea. Alternative to LASIK for high prescriptions, thin corneas, or dry eyes.
- [Dry Eye Treatment](/services/dry-eye): Comprehensive dry eye evaluation and personalized treatment including thermal therapies, prescription medications, and lifestyle optimization.

## Patient Guides
- [Complete Guide to DMEK Surgery](/guides/dmek-surgery): Everything about DMEK corneal transplant — candidacy, procedure, recovery timeline, success rates (80-90% achieve 20/25+), risks, and FAQs.
- [Understanding Fuchs' Dystrophy](/guides/fuchs-dystrophy): Comprehensive guide to Fuchs' Dystrophy — stages, symptoms, diagnosis, treatment options, and when surgery is needed. Affects 4% of adults over 40.
